title: On the bus
setting: A city bus, two stops before the metro.

lines.speaker: Hlášení
lines.unverifiedNote: The usual wording, but not found on an official PID/DPP page: flagged for checking.

lines.speaker: Hlášení
lines.en: To get off, press the button.

verified.source: PID press release: all bus and trolleybus stops become request stops from 29 June 2024

lines.speaker: Paní
lines.en: Excuse me, are you getting off?

lines.speaker: Ty
lines.en: No, let me get out of your way.

note: Since 29 June 2024 every bus and trolleybus stop in the PID network is a request stop: inside, press the button; at the stop, you no longer have to wave (pid.cz, checked 17 Nov 2026).

questions.prompt: What does the announcement ask you to do if you want to get off?
questions.why: Pro výstup stiskněte tlačítko: to get off, press the button.

hints.explain: Waving was for stopping the bus from outside, and PID says you no longer need to do even that. Inside, you press the button.
Standing by the door tells the driver nothing: press the button.
Not any more: since June 2024 all PID bus and trolleybus stops are request stops. If nobody presses, the bus may drive on.

questions.prompt: The woman asks **Vystupujete?** What does she want?
options: To get past you to the door
answers: To get past you to the door
questions.why: Vystupujete? means "Are you getting off?": she wants to get past you. Ne, pustím vás: no, I'll let you through.

hints.explain: That would be Je tady volno? (Is this seat free?).
That would be Jaká je příští zastávka?
